description: The graph represents a decentralized multi-agent Swarm architecture where users design and monitor cognitive workflows via a frontend Canvas/Workflow UI that communicates in real time with a Swarm Core engine. The Swarm Core orchestrates specialized agents using a consensus algorithm (MAKER) and the Actor Model, routing all interactions through a zero-trust Security & Tooling Gateway for validation and external tool execution. Persistent state, conversation lineage, and retrieval are managed by a dual-tier State & Memory Fabric (Redis + Qdrant). An Intelligence & Observability Backend collects telemetry, RAG-model insights, and consensus metrics for analysis, while a Real-time Connectivity Layer streams events between frontend and backend to enable live interaction and visualization.
